pages.title: ExorLive

pages.main_text_excerpt:
About ExorLive
How to move!
At ExorLive, we believe that movement brings joy, energy and better health. That is why we want to inspire movement in all forms and for all types of people, regardless of the situation you are in. For the elderly and for the younger. For those who sit still at work or for those who have a heavy workload. For those who are not well trained and for those who are. For the healthy and for those who are injured or have an illness.
We seek to achieve this through digital solutions that both share knowledge and show how we humans can move.
Therefore, our vision is Show the world how to move!
And our motto: How to move!
Innovative people
We create digital solutions that inspire movement
Engaged customers
Thousands of exercises are shared every day
High competence
We take pride in creating training content for you
A little better each day
In the ExorLive team, we are a colorful bouquet of people with different backgrounds, professions and roles. We see this as an important prerequisite to being able to constantly challenge the status quo and get a little better every day. In a changing world, we are constantly looking to find innovative ways to inspire movement, as well as create solutions that are easy to use and easy to like!
Together with our committed customers and leading professionals in public and private health, fitness and sports, thousands of exercise inspirations are shared every day! We have done this since 2003 and we intend to continue with this. The ever-increasing demand and attention we are experiencing is also something we are looking forward to.
High quality program and exercises
We take pride in creating good and quality-assured content in the form of exercises and program suggestions. The production is managed by our physiotherapist and content manger.
Production and publishing of content in ExorLive is a multi-joint quality assurance process, which mainly relies on research, new concepts and customer wishes.
Content produced at the request of customers is always quality assured and pre-approved by the customer. We also refer to current research, environments or concepts from which the exercises are obtained from, in order to give the users an insight into the academic weight of the exercises/programs - where relevant.
